title: Weighted Besov Spaces on Homogeneous Lie Groups and Applications to Parabolic Anderson Models
summary: We develop an intrinsic theory of weighted, inhomogeneous Besov spaces on general homogeneous Lie groups without recourse to group-specific arguments. Starting from a definition in terms of localised test functions, we establish an equivalent, wavelet-like, multiscale characterisation. This provides a unified mechanism for deriving Besov embeddings, a Taylor-remainder characterisation, Young-type product estimates, Schauder estimates for convolution semigroups, and a weighted Kolmogorov criterion for random distributions. We apply this framework to parabolic Anderson-type equations…
